user.title: Add a room
user.description: A room needs at least one heater. Without temperature sensors of its own it borrows a neighbour's reading.

data_description.heaters: Every switch this room heats with. One loop runs per heater.
data_description.temperature_sensors: The room's own sensors. The reading is their average.
data_description.neighbour: Used only where the room has no sensor of its own.
data_description.window_sensor: Heating stops while this says open.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Sets how hard the room fires while it holds.
data_description.power_sensor: Confirms the heater actually ran. A room without one behaves exactly as this one does.

error.no_heater: A room needs at least one heater.
A room needs at least one heater.

warm_room_by.name: Warm the room to a temperature by a time
warm_room_by.description: Starts the room early enough to be at the temperature by the time given, and runs at full output until it is there.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature the room is to reach.

by_time.name: Wanted by
by_time.description: When the room is to be at that temperature. A time alone means the next time it comes round.

hold_temperature.name: Hold the room at a temperature until it expires
hold_temperature.description: Holds the temperature for the time given, then falls back to the room's target.

set_warming_rate.name: Set how fast the room warms
set_warming_rate.description: The rate the room works backwards from when it is given a deadline.

measured_at_outdoor.name: Measured at
measured_at_outdoor.description: The outdoor temperature that rate was measured at.

set_regulation.name: Set how the room is regulated
set_regulation.description: The numbers the room's loop runs on until it is given others.

behaviour.name: Holding behaviour
behaviour.description: Paced runs a fraction of each cycle. A plain band switches at the edges.

band.name: Band
band.description: How far the room may drift either side of its target. Setting it locks it.

outdoor_shift_per_degree.name: Outdoor shift
outdoor_shift_per_degree.description: Extra output per degree the target sits above the outdoor temperature.

cycle_length.name: Cycle length
cycle_length.description: How long one paced cycle lasts.

full_output_below.name: Full output below
full_output_below.description: How far below target the room runs flat out.

shortest_time_between_relay_changes.name: Shortest time between relay changes
shortest_time_between_relay_changes.description: Protects the relay's contacts. It overrides the band.

switched.name: Switched
switched.description: On or off for a room with no temperature reading. Its own dial holds the temperature.

return_to_target.name: Return the room to its target
return_to_target.description: Ends any warm-up and any timed hold. The room holds the temperature it was last set.
